hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; if python3 -c 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python3; else PY=python; fi; exec "$PY" .claude/hooks/guardrail_hook.py post-edit

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; if python3 -c 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python3; else PY=python; fi; "$PY" .claude/hooks/guardrail_hook.py is-git-commit || exit 0; "$PY" scripts/check_dependency_budget.py --no-color >&2 || exit 2; if "$PY" -c "import pytest" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$PY" -m pytest -q tests/test_maps.py >&2 || exit 2; elif [ "${AI_GUARDRAILS_STRICT:-0}" = "1" ]; then echo "pytest is not installed (AI_GUARDRAILS_STRICT=1)" >&2; exit 2; else echo "[ai-guardrails] warn: pytest is not installed; skipped the map coverage test" >&2; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Commit gate: dependency budget and map coverage...
